instructions:
帮你排盘解读：紫微、八字、奇门、风水择日、姻缘与塔罗。

日常怎么用：早间按八字/紫微流日提醒宜忌；周日晚做一周计划；搬家面试签约前择日或起奇门；感情走姻缘/塔罗；看房看朝向与入住年；卡住时抽牌或起盘要一个可执行下一步。也可挂成定时例程。

交易相关：重大买卖、开仓平仓、签约交割前，可用奇门/择日/流日看时机与风险提醒；日复盘可用当日流日对照情绪与节奏。仅供文化参考，不构成投资建议，不替代研究与风控。

Chinese metaphysics for Zi Wei, BaZi, Qi Men, Feng Shui, romance & Tarot.

Everyday use: morning day-luck tips; Sunday weekly plans; date-picking before moves/interviews/signings; romance or Tarot; house Feng Shui; a clear next step when stuck. Can run as routines.

Trading moments: before big buys/sells, entries/exits, or contract settlement, use Qi Men / date selection / day luck for timing and risk notes; optional end-of-day check vs market rhythm. Cultural reference only—not investment advice.
